mapper.select: -- 步骤1: 使用 LEAD 函数定义出每次停车的起止时间窗口 WITH parking_intervals AS ( SELECT d.id as drive_id, d.car_id, d.end_position_id, d.end_date AS parking_start_date, LEAD(d.start_date, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.car_id ORDER BY d.start_date) AS parking_end_date FROM drives d WHERE d.car_id = #{carId} ) -- 步骤2: 关联查询，获取最终结果 SELECT pi.drive_id, pi.car_id, start_pos.latitude, start_pos.longitude, pi.parking_start_date, pi.parking_end_date, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (pi.parking_end_date - pi.parking_start_date)) AS parking_duration_seconds, start_pos.usable_battery_level AS battery_level_start, start_pos.est_battery_range_km AS range_km_start, -- 关键改动：从 end_pos 子查询中获取停车结束时的数据 end_pos.usable_battery_level AS battery_level_end, end_pos.est_battery_range_km AS range_km_end FROM parking_intervals pi -- 关联 positions 表获取停车开始时的准确数据 (这部分总是可靠的) JOIN positions start_pos ON pi.end_position_id = start_pos.id -- 使用 LATERAL JOIN 智能查找停车结束时的第一条有效数据 , LATERAL ( SELECT p.usable_battery_level, p.est_battery_range_km FROM positions p WHERE p.car_id = pi.car_id AND p.date >= pi.parking_end_date AND p.usable_battery_level IS NOT NULL AND p.est_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.date ASC LIMIT 1 ) end_pos WHERE pi.parking_end_date IS NOT NULL AND to_char(pi.parking_start_date, 'YYYY-MM') = #{month} AND (pi.parking_end_date - pi.parking_start_date) > interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY pi.parking_start_date DESC
